articles.summary: CARMEL, Ind., June 25, 2024 — MBX Biosciences, Inc., a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery and development of novel precision peptide therapies for the treatment of endocrine and metabolic disorders, today announced the appointment of Salomon (Sam) Azoulay, M.D, as Chief Medical Officer (CMO).
